messages:
Sam: Hey team — first week here. Quick Q: where's the canonical onboarding docs/Notion space? I found the Company Handbook but not sure which pages I should edit for team notes and runbook templates. Who owns the templates? Thanks
Priya: Welcome Sam! :tada: The main place is the Engineering -> Docs space in Notion (internal link).
Priya: Short answers — Templates live in the Templates subpage under Engineering -> Docs. Team-owned pages (playbooks, oncall runbooks, product PRDs) have an owner listed at the top and are locked to editors.
Sam: Got it. Can I duplicate the runbook template and edit the copy, or do I need explicit edit perms to do anything?
Priya: You can duplicate templates with Can View access and start drafting. For editing canonical team pages you need to be added as an editor. To request that, use the Request Docs Access form or ping the page owner.
Sam: Where's the Request Docs Access form? Slack slash command?
Devex Bot: Tip — use the Request Docs Access form: https://forms.redwood.internal/docs-access (this routes to devex and suggests owners). There's also a short checklist on the Templates page about meta fields to include.
Leo: If you're going to touch the oncall runbook, ping me. I own that page and will add you as editor.
Sam: Thanks @Leo — will do. Also: any naming conventions for micro-docs? component notes vs architecture pages?
Priya: Yes — we prefer: "Team / Component — Short title". Add the meta header at the top with Owner, Last updated, Status (draft|stable). Use the template that pre-populates the blocks: Owner, Audience, TL;DR, Steps, Rollback.
Sam: Perfect — copied the template and filed a request via the form. I'll draft the db-migration note and link it to the component page.
Priya: Nice. If you want walkthrough help, DM me and we can do a 15m screen-share to set up page permissions and the table-of-contents blocks. Welcome again! :wave:
